page.layout: One block, centred: title page of a book, all lines centred, no columns or margins. Library stamps (Biblioteca Naz. Roma, Bibliothèque seals) and a Google watermark are left out.

main_text.l: Primores duo nunc primitus prodeunt, reliqvis
Typis F. Flesheri, impensis L. Sadleri Bibliopolæ, commorantis in vico vulgò vocato Little Britain, apud quem prostant venales. 1651.

page.notes: The word before "ORUM" is hidden by a library stamp (Biblioteca Naz. Roma, Vittorio Emanuele); it is probably "CONTRA" or similar and is marked illegible. "Little Britain" and "Britain" are in black letter in the original. The date 1651 is printed. The Latin "Typis" line is set in mixed roman and italic type.
